##### Project general facts

Evora Residences by ANAX Developments is a contemporary residential building that pairs modern luxury with practical, well-considered design. The building rises from a ground floor and a podium level to ten residential floors topped by a roof level that completes its refined architectural profile. The collection offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts, high-quality finishes and balconies, creating comfortable homes suited to professionals, couples and growing families seeking a balanced everyday lifestyle.

Amenities are curated for relaxation, fitness and family time. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool with a floating deck and sun loungers, a separate children's pool and a children's play area, as well as a barbecue area and a bar deck for social evenings. A fully equipped gym, an indoor yoga studio, a meditation zone and a jogging track support an active routine, while landscaped gardens, covered parking, lifts and comprehensive security with video surveillance add comfort and peace of mind.

Interiors balance aesthetics and practicality, with open living areas, generous storage and quality materials throughout. Kitchens are equipped with Bosch appliances, and bathrooms feature premium sanitary fittings by Teka, while an integrated smart home system makes daily living more efficient. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and allowing every apartment to be completed with personal touches.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a thriving residential community in the Jebel Ali area, known for its low-rise villas, townhouses and boutique apartment buildings set among landscaped parks and walkable streets. Playgrounds, sports courts, cycling and jogging tracks and the Al Furjan Pavilion with its cafes, restaurants and supermarkets create a friendly, family-oriented setting with everyday needs close at hand.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Sheikh Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city, while the Al Furjan metro station on the Red Line is within walking distance of the building. Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Ibn Battuta Mall and Expo City Dubai are a short drive away, and Al Maktoum International Airport is within comfortable reach, along with schools, nurseries and medical centres serving local families.

Al Furjan is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular mid-market residential addresses in Dubai. Metro access, proximity to the Dubai South and Expo City growth corridor and an established family lifestyle support steady tenant demand from professionals working in Jebel Ali and Dubai Marina. Competitive entry prices compared with the coastal districts underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners.
